newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CNA Gallo restructuring talks continue.
newsitem.headline: CNA Gallo restructuring talks continue.

text.p: Leading South African retailer CNA Gallo Ltd on Friday advised shareholders that negotiations involving the possible restructuring of the group are still continuing.
It advised shareholders to continue exercising caution in dealing in CNA Gallo shares until a further announcement is published.
CNA Gallo first announced it was mulling a restructuring on May 12.
It said it aimed to more effectively capitalise on opportunities for growth of its entertainment and leisure activities.
